title: Coordinate parallel delivery without confusing progress with proof
statement: As a change author, I can divide a design into dependency-aware, mergeable work, so that parallel contributors can coordinate without mistaking progress for delivery.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A plan groups work items into ordered delivery waves.
Each work item states one objective.
Each work item lists its expected deliverables.
A dependency states the condition that releases its dependent work item.
A workspace assignment identifies the branch responsible for one work item.
A merge record identifies the delivered unit and its outcome.
Progress alone does not mark an acceptance criterion delivered.
